title: Week in Orbit
summary: The space industry is experiencing a mix of strategic partnerships and budgetary boosts, while some projects face delays and cancellations. As defense tech continues to evolve, the interplay between commercial interests and government needs remains a focal point.

themes.title: Budget Increases for Space Resilience
themes.body: The FY27 budget markup adds $1.4 billion to the space resilience line, signaling a growing commitment to fortifying U.S. capabilities in space. This funding could bolster various initiatives, especially as geopolitical tensions rise.

themes.title: Partnerships in Tactical Constellations
themes.body: Anduril and L3Harris are teaming up on a tactical SDA constellation bid, highlighting a trend of collaboration among defense contractors. Such partnerships may streamline efforts to meet urgent military satellite needs.

themes.title: Challenges in Satellite Insurance
themes.body: Recent GEO cancellations are complicating recovery efforts in space insurance, raising questions about the sustainability of satellite investments. Insurers may need to reevaluate risk models as the market adjusts.

themes.title: AI's Growing Role in Defense
themes.body: The surge in 'AI for Defense' startups indicates a shift in how technology is being integrated into military operations. As companies like Tilebox launch new AI workflows, the defense sector is poised for a tech-driven transformation.
